name: font-family-select
title: Font family select
description: Choose a typeface from a list where every font is set in its own face, with a live sample that previews the highlighted one.
docs: fonts is a list of { family, stack, label?, group? }: stack is the CSS font-family list the font is drawn with and the value the field reports, so a font that is not there still draws as the next family in its list. The field never loads a font. It draws each name in its own stack and asks the browser which fonts it can draw (a web font that finishes loading is noticed), marks the ones it cannot with 'Not loaded', and says in words which font the sample falls back to. The list opens under the sample, so the sample is never covered: it follows the highlighted font while the list is open, and Escape closes the list and puts it back on the chosen font. Nothing above the list changes height with the font on show: the sample box is always sampleLines tall (2 lines by default, 3 in a field narrower than about 17rem, and a longer sample ends in an ellipsis) and the line that says a font is not loaded keeps its row while any font in the list is missing, so the list never moves under the pointer or the arrow keys. groups sets the order of the headings, recent takes the stacks to pin under Recent (without it the field remembers what was chosen since it appeared), and a screen reader hears each font's name and group. messages replaces the words.
